title: Codex CLI — one turn, end to end
example_input: refactor the retry helper to use exponential backoff
note: TUI → app-server → core. Pinned at rust-v0.160.0.

steps.title: Submit
steps.narrative: The user types 'refactor the retry helper to use exponential backoff' in the TUI and hits Enter. The TUI sends app-server RPC turn/start (app_server_session.rs:1308-1341), packaging the text with sandbox-policy and permission overrides resolved from config.

steps.title: Route to core
steps.narrative: turn_processor.rs:630 → thread.start_or_steer_turn(...) → Op::TurnInput (protocol.rs:622) → session/handlers.rs:485 → turn_input::handle. The op enum is the entire vocabulary the server speaks to core.

steps.title: Start task
steps.narrative: No active turn → spawn_task (turn_input.rs:365) → tasks/mod.rs:287 records ActiveTurn and spawns with a fresh CancellationToken.

steps.title: Task loop
steps.narrative: RegularTask::run (tasks/regular.rs:40) emits TurnStarted and enters its loop {} (:104), calling run_turn (:105) with the input, MCP startup requirements, and any prewarmed client session.

steps.title: Turn preamble
steps.narrative: Inside run_turn (turn.rs:163): guardian check, pre-sampling compaction, MCP resolution, the first step-context capture, skill/plugin injection, session-start hooks — then the user message is recorded to history.
steps.representation:
run_turn(sess, turn_context, input, ...)
  → guardian check, compaction, MCP, step-context
  → user message → history

steps.title: Drain + prompt hooks
steps.narrative: The loop {} body (turn.rs:426): no pending input to drain on a fresh turn; prompt-hook inspection runs (:426-446).
steps.representation:
loop {} (:426)
  → drain pending input (none)
  → prompt-hook inspection

steps.title: Step context
steps.narrative: Tools re-resolved, approval policy bound to the turn (turn.rs:461-503); time reminder and world state assembled. Context, advertised tools, and tool calls share one request view.
steps.representation:
capture_step_context(...)
  → tools re-resolved
  → approval policy bound → world state

steps.title: Prompt build
steps.narrative: clone_history().await.for_prompt(...) plus executed_tool_calls.attach_to_prompt → build_prompt → Prompt { input, tools, parallel_tool_calls: true, base_instructions, ... } (turn.rs:1583-1592).
steps.representation:
for_prompt(history + tool calls)
  → build_prompt → Prompt
  → parallel_tool_calls: true

steps.title: Model call
steps.narrative: run_sampling_request → try_run_sampling_request → client_session.stream(...) → WebSocket-first (permanent HTTP/SSE fallback), both POSTing to /responses (client.rs:2218-2263). The request carries store: false, stream: true, and a thread-scoped prompt_cache_key for cache affinity (client.rs:886-1007).
steps.representation:
run_sampling_request
  → client_session.stream(...) → /responses
  → store: false, stream: true, prompt_cache_key

steps.title: Stream handling
steps.narrative: The inner loop (turn.rs:2605) consumes ResponseEvents: text deltas stream to the TUI live; each completed tool call arrives as OutputItemDone → ToolRouter::build_tool_call (stream_events_utils.rs:325), spawned into in_flight with needs_follow_up = true.
steps.representation:
loop {} (:2605) consumes ResponseEvents
  → text deltas → TUI (live)
  → OutputItemDone → build_tool_call → in_flight

steps.title: Approval (parked)
steps.narrative: For any gated call, ApprovalService::request_approval (tools/approvals.rs:479) runs hooks → Guardian → user; the turn loop sits in drain_in_flight (turn.rs:2466) until the decision lands. Denials become failure tool results, not loop breaks.
steps.representation:
gated call → request_approval
  → hooks → Guardian → user
  → loop parked in drain_in_flight

steps.title: Loop or stop
steps.narrative: drain_in_flight records every FunctionCallOutput envelope into history (turn.rs:2466-2492). needs_follow_up = true → continue (turn.rs:725): iteration 2 rebuilds the prompt from history now containing tool results. The model replies with only an assistant message → !needs_follow_up → stop hooks → post-turn compaction check → break (turn.rs:653-723). run_turn returns Ok(last_agent_message) (:839); TurnCompleted is emitted and the TUI renders from the streamed events.
steps.representation:
drain_in_flight → history
  → needs_follow_up ? continue (:725) : break (:653)
  → Ok(last_agent_message) (:839) → TurnCompleted
